europe_now.title: Wave of Russian sabotage attacks exposes counter-intelligence gaps on Nato’s eastern flank
europe_now.summary: A series of Russian sabotage operations has been reported across NATO’s eastern flank, revealing weaknesses in counter‑intelligence capabilities. The incidents highlight systemic security concerns for European allies operating in the region.

sources.headline: Wave of Russian sabotage attacks exposes counter-intelligence gaps on Nato’s eastern flank

europe_now.title: Ukraine renews push for Russia’s frozen assets
europe_now.summary: Ukraine is seeking to access and utilize frozen Russian sovereign assets to fund its reconstruction and defense needs. The move reflects broader European discussions on leveraging sanctions proceeds for post‑war recovery.

sources.headline: Ukraine renews push for Russia’s frozen assets

top_stories.title: French government promises €1B for drought-stricken farmers
top_stories.summary: The French government has announced a one‑billion‑euro aid package for farmers hit by drought and extreme heat. The funding is intended to offset losses from climate‑related crop failures in the affected regions.

sources.headline: French government promises €1B for drought-stricken farmers

top_stories.title: 'Worst possible timing': Farage's Reform UK meets as new donation scandal hits
top_stories.summary: Reform UK, led by Nigel Farage, held a meeting while facing allegations of a new donation scandal. The timing of the gathering has attracted criticism as the party’s fundraising practices come under scrutiny.

sources.headline: 'Worst possible timing': Farage's Reform UK meets as new donation scandal hits

top_stories.title: Strength of Meloni less linked to policy, more about her party's dominance within govt coalition
top_stories.summary: Observers note that Giorgia Meloni’s political strength derives mainly from her party’s control of the governing coalition rather than from policy successes. This reliance on coalition dominance raises questions about the longevity of her government’s policy agenda.

sources.headline: Strength of Meloni less linked to policy, more about her party's dominance within govt coalition
